eclipse-theia-theia-agents-update-defaul.description: Monthly refresh of the default LLM models of Theia's language model aliases (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google), including the per-model capability tables that cannot be auto-discovered. Use when asked to update the default models, aliases or provider model lists.

eclipse-theia-theia-agents-update-depend.description: Update dependencies of the Theia framework and record what was learned. Its main use is the post-release dependency update after every minor release (NPM upgrade that reduces dependency vulnerabilities reported by npm audit and Dependabot, Electron update, Node.js/React check). Also covers single updates on demand (Electron, Monaco, TypeScript, Node.js, React, AI provider SDKs, vulnerable dependencies), on master or a `release/x.y.x` branch. Use when asked for the "post-release update", "npm upgrade", "update/upgrade/bump <dependency>", to reduce dependency vulnerabilities or npm audit…
